jei.pollutionplus.description.powered_fi:
Instead of using traditional filters, this type of "filter" uses power to delete the pollutants.

Each tier has varying power requirements and cooldowns.

The cooldown is the time between deleting a pollutant and not how often they try to delete.
block.pollutionplus.infinite_filter.jei:
A filter that once activated using the activation item (by default nether star), will forever delete pollution passing through it.

Has no cooldown on the filtering speed, activation item dropped when destroyed.
block.pollutionplus.pollution_deleter.je:
Large scale pollution deletion machine that deletes all pollution between 2 points.

Goes block by block with a set cooldown.

Use a location marker to more easily set the points.
block.pollutionplus.incinerator.jei: Deletes all pollution around it self in one big burst requiring lots of power.
block.pollutionplus.pollution_pump.jei:
Pumps pollution from around the top pollution pipe connected to the top of the pump.

The pump will try to push the pumped pollutants into horizontally adjacent filters (from PollutionPlus & Adpother). If there's none, a random side with be chosen to pump the pollution to.

A pollution pipe IS required for the pump to function!
block.pollutionplus.pipe.jei:
Used for the pollution pump to reach pollution.

Works similar to scaffolding (building, removing).
item.pollutionplus.location_marker.jei:
Sneak right click a block to save its position, or sneak right click in the air to save the players position.

Right clicking a pollution deleter with a marker with a saved position will set the deleter's start point to the saved position. Sneak right clicking will set the deleter's end point instead.
jei.pollutionplus.infinite_filter.title: Infinite Filter Activation
tooltip.pollutionplus.infinite_filter: Right click with a "%s" to activate
tooltip.pollutionplus.location_marker.hi: Sneak right click a block or in the air to record a position
